sec-pidex-title: PiDEX — Asaɣar n Pi War Asr
sec-pidex-sub: PiDEX yebda deg Yebrir 2025. Asaɣar n Pi tokens s tazlaft deg usnimet n Pi.
pidex-what-body: PiDEX d asaɣar n Pi Network igaran deg Pi Browser. Yessar imedanen ad saɣren Pi tokens sɣur wid-nni, s war tazimant n Pi ɣer dagi n urti.
pidex-access-body: Ldi Pi Browser → nadi PiDEX → kcem s Pi Network. Ilaq ad tgeḍ KYC u ad tiliḍ d Pi Wallet tettekki.
pidex-trade-body: Adday 1: Ldi PiDEX deg Pi Browser. Adday 2: Fren agrudem n token. Adday 3: Rnu amḍan. Adday 4: Hwu tigejda. Adday 5: Sned — yettemsar zi dɣa ɣer Pi blockchain.
pidex-safety-body: Kcem PiDEX s Pi Browser s wiss garu. Ur tessexdameḍ tibibbawin n berra. Ur tsinniḍ awal-ik n usegdel. Saɣer tokens n Pi ecosystem kan.

sec-pilaunch-title: Pi Launchpad — Asmel n Ifran n Tokens
sec-pilaunch-sub: Pi Launchpad Testnet yebda deg Yebrir 2025. Mudd Pi, Kamm Pi, u af tokens yesɣen.
pilaunch-what-body: Pi Launchpad d asmel n ifran n tokens n Pi Network. Imahalen yesɣen n Pi ecosystem sakʷen Pi sɣur tmetti — sɣuren-d imdanen s tokens yesɣen.
pilaunch-stake-body: Staking d asnulfuti n wamur n Pi inek deg kontrat n tyerza i weswuf n usefrak. Pi tesnulfut tafk-ak-d aẓref n usɣur n token.
pilaunch-commit-body: Committing d tigawt TAFRANT. S deffir n usnulfut, Ilaq ad tkemmeḍ Pi inek ɣer umahil arnu i wusɣur. Staking kan UMA YALI — rnu TIGAWT SNAT.
pilaunch-slice-title: SLICE — Ifran wis sin n Testnet
pilaunch-slice-body: SLICE d token wis sin deg Pi Launchpad Testnet. Yettusemras i uɣewweṛ n tameẓla. Imedanen muddent u kemmment Pi rẓan tokens SLICE.
pilaunch-earn-title: Amek ara naf Tokens n Launchpad
pilaunch-earn-body: Adday 1: Pi Browser → Pi Launchpad. Adday 2: Nadi afran token iddar. Adday 3: MUDD Pi inek. Adday 4: KAMM Pi inek ɣer umahil. Adday 5: Ṭṭef d aɣellal. Adday 6: Af tokens wissik.
